purpose: Account for every original, compatibility, corrective, delegating, repairing, shadow, and transition-only runtime asset and govern its movement into the single GATE 3.0 architecture.
retirement_package_requirements: current owner and protected behavior indexed
manual operational validation completed where applicable
legacy imports, injections, globals, selectors, and references removed
legacy file removed or isolated as non-executable history
runtime and repository reference scans pass
active asset budget is net-negative or explicitly justified

phase_retirement_intent.phase_1: Index every asset and assign target owner, final disposition, retirement phase, acceptance gate, and removal verification method.
phase_retirement_intent.phase_2: Establish the complete GATE 3.0 enterprise foundation without creating an uncontrolled parallel production runtime.
phase_retirement_intent.phase_3: Transfer subsystem ownership to GATE 3.0 and retire superseded owners in bounded, parity-proven packages.
phase_retirement_intent.phase_4: Complete unified route, shell, design, responsive, accessibility, and operational-platform ownership; remove remaining transition layers.
phase_retirement_intent.phase_5: Certify the GATE 3.0-only runtime, remove remaining dead or orphaned files, isolate historical evidence, and prove no legacy execution path remains.
